gate_type: D-DAY TRACK B — DDAY-B6 PLANTOS LOCAL INTEGRATION PROOF + LIGHTWEIGHT WHOLE FACTORY OVERVIEW
objective: Prove a workspace-local PlantOS-compatible ingestion path for the existing autonomous Bottled Water factory (B1 MQTT JSON topic/payload, stable Plant/Area/Asset/Signal IDs, current values, historian buffer, events) and add a bounded Whole Factory Overview that reads that same factory state. The overview shows the five accepted areas, process/utility relationships, key raw values, area abnormal state, and drill-down from BW-FP to the existing Filling & Packaging UI. No second simulator, no duplicate topology/state, no PlantOS-owned KPI, no full HMI product.

conservative_interpretation.issue_110_live_read: Live Issue #110 could not be fetched (GitHub App token has no issues:read; GraphQL unresolved / REST 403 / public HTML 404). This contract is authored from B1 §7/§8/§10 (B6 = PlantOS local integration proof, MQTT JSON primary), the B5 CLOSED authorization that B6 may proceed only under a separate SA Issue, and the explicit user execution order for the updated B6 including the Lightweight Whole Factory Overview for D-Day.
conservative_interpretation.integration_proof: Map the existing factory snapshot to B1 MQTT JSON messages in a workspace-local mapper. Ingest them into an in-memory PlantOS-compatible sink (current values + bounded historian + events). Topic pattern virtual-factory/bottled-water-dday/{kind}/{asset_id}/{signal_or_event}. Payload fields match the B1 samples. IDs resolve against the frozen topology plantos_mapping. Existing MqttGateway.publish_raw may be composed as optional transport; protocols/ and telemetry/ are not edited. REST /bottled-water-demo/plantos-export is a debug/verification path only.
conservative_interpretation.overview: A new VF page at /bottled-water-demo/overview reads GET /bottled-water-demo/factory. It is an observer plus the existing five operator controls and a BW-FP drill-down to /bottled-water-demo. It is not a second simulator, not a duplicate topology, and not a PlantOS HMI product.
conservative_interpretation.stop_if_generic_change: If PlantOS production-code changes or generic protocol/telemetry changes become required, STOP for SA authorization. This slice must complete without those changes.
conservative_interpretation.no_kpi: Do not calculate or publish OEE, availability, performance, quality %, energy/unit, utilization, or health score. Area abnormal state is the already-public Capper/Compressor phase or the area operating_state.
conservative_interpretation.capper_compressor: Do not modify capper/compressor helpers, contracts, or runtimes. Do not expand scenario fidelity.
